title: Genesis 22:2 — take your son, your only son Isaac; et marks each object
summary: Genesis 22:2 in English and Hebrew: God tells Abraham to take his son, his only son, Isaac, to the land of Moriah and offer him as a burnt offering. The untranslated Hebrew word את (et, alef-tav, alef in blue and tav in red) is inserted in the English before 'your son', 'your only son' and 'Isaac', which are underlined along with the matching Hebrew words; 'Moriah' is in brown. The bottom line reads 'et את alef tav'.

text.text: 2 He said, “Take now את your son, את your only son, whom you love, את Isaac, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains of which I will tell you.”
2 ויאמר קח־נא את־בנך את־יחידך אשר־אהבת את־יצחק ולך־לך אל־ארץ המריה והעלהו שם לעלה על אחד ההרים אשר אמר אליך׃

words.gloss: alef-tav; untranslated direct-object marker placed before each thing Abraham is told to take

letters.meaning: first letter of et; shown in blue
last letter of et; shown in red
